text:
Devon P.: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting the release notes for next Wed's microdeploy. Need a short internal blurb + who to CC for SRE/Support standby.
Maria L.: Thanks. Can you include the pinning note for models v2.3.1 -> v2.3.2? Ops wants explicit rollback keys.
Devon P.: Yep — plan is to pin traffic to v2.3.2 in canary, hold 30m, then promote. Rollback criteria: error rate > 1.5% 5m rolling or latency P95 > 600ms 10m.
Jenna C.: Add note about embedding index rebuild window — that job runs for 20m after deploy. Support should warn customers about temporary degradation for similarity searches.
Sachin R.: @Devon P. what time window are we aiming for? timezone-sensitive teams need the UTC and PDT times.
Devon P.: Target window: Wed 22:00 UTC (Wed 15:00 PDT). Change window = 60m, expected ~20m active changes + 40m monitoring.
Lina K.: For the internal announce copy: short one-liner + bullet list of visible changes and rollback instructions. I'll own broadcast in #all-hands if you approve.
Devon P.: Draft for review:

"Release: microdeploy v2.3.2 — rolling canary at Wed 22:00 UTC. Highlights: inference runtime perf tweaks, KV cache prefetch fix, and embedding index refresh. Ops will monitor and can rollback to v2.3.1 on threshold breach. Expected user impact: minor latency blips during index rebuild."

Thoughts?
Maria L.: Looks good. Add a line: "If you rely on pinned model versions, verify your pinned references remain intact — contact infra if unexpected switching occurs."
Jenna C.: Suggest adding the deploy-bot command snippet so the ops runbook links are discoverable.
Devon P.: Good call. Deploy snippet:
```
/deploy canary v2.3.2 --zone=eu-west-1 --timeout=60m --watch
```
deploy-bot: queued canary rollout request by Devon P. for v2.3.2. See /deploy status 9405001234 for details.
Sachin R.: For rollback steps, a tiny checklist is helpful in the blurb:
- /deploy rollback v2.3.2 -> v2.3.1
- disable canary routing
- notify support@redwood

Lina K.: I'll trim the copy for the internal blast. One ask: include a link to the canary playbook and the evacs page.
Devon P.: Links:
- Canary playbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/canary-playbook
- Evacuation runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/evac-runbook

Also tagging: @sre-oncall and @support-lead in the blast.
Maria L.: final nit: add a short "what to look for" bulletset for oncall: spike in 500s, memory growth on gpu-hosts, embedding job timeouts.
Devon P.: Updated draft pushed. Lina, can you run the internal dry-run tomorrow and post the pin-check table? I want a quick signoff before Wed.
Lina K.: Yep, I'll run the dry-run at Tue 16:00 UTC and post results here. If anything odd, we'll delay the window by 24h.
infra-bot: reminder: scheduled maintenance collision check completed — no collisions detected in target window.
deploy-bot: reminder: ensure /deploy canary command is run from ops pipeline. Automated monitors will evaluate thresholds.
Devon P.: Thanks team — final signoffs by Tue 20:00 UTC please. I'll merge the release notes and hand to Lina for the internal announcement after that. :thumbsup:
